name: HandiFox Online
description_en:
HandiFox Online is cloud inventory software with web and Android/iOS workflows. It can operate standalone or synchronize with QuickBooks Online; HandiFox Desktop is a separate product for QuickBooks Desktop.

Online covers receiving, counting, transfers and purchasing, with sales and fulfillment depth varying by plan. Device allowances are distinct from user accounts, an important distinction when staff share warehouse scanners.
description_zh:
HandiFox Online 提供网页和 Android/iOS 云库存流程，可独立运行或与 QuickBooks Online 同步；面向 QuickBooks Desktop 的 HandiFox Desktop 是另一产品。

Online 覆盖收货、盘点、转移和采购，销售与履约深度按方案不同。设备额度与用户账户分开计算，员工共享仓库扫描器时尤其需要注意。

core_features.explanation_en: Online describes scanning while receiving, counting, transferring, picking/packing and selling.
core_features.explanation_zh: Online 描述在收货、盘点、转移、拣配和销售时扫描。

core_features.name_zh: 可选 QuickBooks Online 同步
core_features.explanation_en: The pricing FAQ permits standalone use and distinguishes Online from the Desktop integration product.
core_features.explanation_zh: 价格 FAQ 允许独立使用，并区分 Online 与 Desktop 集成产品。

use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation scenario, not observed customer adoption.

pricing.billing_basis: Observed Online Start/Optima/Pro: $49/$95/$129 annual monthly equivalents, $59/$105/$159 monthly; stale promotion dates prevent confirming offer validity.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Observed Online Start/Optima/Pro: $49/$95/$129 annual monthly equivalents, $59/$105/$159 monthly; stale promotion dates prevent confirming offer validity.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 实读 Online Start/Optima/Pro：年付月均 $49/$95/$129，月付 $59/$105/$159；过期促销日期导致有效性待确认。

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent validation.
Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.en: Define items, units and locations, then receive a purchase order from a mobile device. Move part of the quantity to a second location and fulfill a sale, checking QuickBooks records if connected. Pro explicitly adds sales orders, pick/pack and serial/lot/expiry functions. Use a partial receipt and credit memo to test the workflow your business actually needs.
sections.zh: 定义商品、单位与地点，再用移动设备接收采购单，将部分数量转到另一地点并完成销售；如连接 QuickBooks，应核对其记录。Pro 明确增加销售订单、拣配及序列号、批次、有效期功能。应加入部分收货和贷项通知，测试真实所需流程。

sections.title_en: Count people, devices and locations separately
sections.title_zh: 分别计算人员、设备与地点
sections.en: Start lists two users, one device and one location; Optima four users, two devices and three locations; Pro five users and three devices. Pro’s headline says unlimited locations while the comparison table says 100, so the actual ceiling requires confirmation. Extra users are listed at $15 monthly and extra mobile devices at $40 monthly.
sections.zh: Start 列出两用户、一设备、一地点；Optima 四用户、两设备、三地点；Pro 五用户、三设备。Pro 标题写地点不限，对照表却写 100，实际地点上限需确认。额外用户标价每月 $15，额外移动设备每月 $40。

sections.title_en: Resolve stale promotion wording before purchase
sections.title_zh: 购买前解决过期促销文字
sections.en: The page shows Online annual monthly equivalents of $49/$95/$129 and monthly billing of $59/$105/$159 for Start/Optima/Pro. It also displays “Until August 1st” and first-year discount language, which is temporally stale at the October research date. Treat the amounts as observed page content, not a confirmed currently redeemable offer. Desktop perpetual-device license prices do not apply to Online.
sections.zh: 页面显示 Online Start/Optima/Pro 年付月均 $49/$95/$129，月付 $59/$105/$159，同时仍写“截至 8 月 1 日”和首年折扣，早于本次十月研究日期。因此这些是页面实读金额，不能确认为当前可兑现优惠。Desktop 按设备永久许可的价格不适用于 Online。

sections.title_en: Verify accounting compatibility during the trial
sections.title_zh: 试用中验证会计兼容性
sections.en: A 14-day Online trial and onboarding training are advertised. Small teams using QuickBooks Online can evaluate warehouse mobility without replacing accounting. Confirm the supported QuickBooks edition and region, synchronization direction, tax handling and duplicate recovery. Offline operation and actual device-sharing behavior were not tested.
sections.zh: 官网提供 14 天 Online 试用及上线培训。使用 QuickBooks Online 的小团队可在保留会计系统的同时评估移动仓库能力。应确认支持的 QuickBooks 版本与地区、同步方向、税务处理及重复记录恢复。离线作业和实际设备共享行为未测试。
